text:
sophie: FYI I'm opening a docs PR to add concrete backoff+jitter examples for SDK snippets (Python/TS/Go) and a short migration note for streaming+pagination retries. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — would love a quick look for accuracy and wording. cc @tim @raul

tim: thanks — will skim. main question: do we want to recommend ‘full jitter’ or ‘decorrelated jitter’ in examples?

sophie: leaning full jitter (AWS style) as the default snippet — simpler to reason about. we can mention alternatives in a footnote.

raul: full jitter SGTM. for streaming retries we should show how to preserve resume state (cursor/event-id) to avoid duped output. maybe a small pattern: keep last_event_id and include it in retry request header.

sophie: yep — adding a short pattern for stream resumption + idempotency. rough Python example I put in the PR:
```python
from time import sleep
import random

def backoff(attempt, base=0.5, cap=10):
    # full jitter
    exp = min(cap, base * 2 ** attempt)
    return random.uniform(0, exp)

# usage in recv loop
for attempt in range(6):
    try:
        for chunk in client.stream_generate(req):
            process(chunk)
        break
    except TransientError:
        delay = backoff(attempt)
        sleep(delay)
        continue
```

tim: nice, short and clear. for TS I'll add the async iterator + fetch-retry snippet (keeps lastCursor). can you add a one-line note about setting a request-id header for idempotency?

sophie: added note in PR about x-rw-request-id. also added a tiny Go example for pagination with retry on page fetch:
```go
func fetchPageWithRetry(ctx context.Context, client *rw.Client, req PageRequest) (Page, error) {
    var lastErr error
    for attempt:=0; attempt<5; attempt++ {
        page, err := client.FetchPage(ctx, req)
        if err == nil {
            return page, nil
        }
        lastErr = err
        sleepDuration := time.Duration(rand.Int63n(int64(math.Min(1000*(1<<attempt), 10000)))) * time.Millisecond // full jitter
        time.Sleep(sleepDuration)
    }
    return Page{}, lastErr
}
```

maria: quick nit: can we avoid referencing third-party libs in the core snippets (e.g., tenacity) to keep examples minimal? also add a one-sentence migration blurb: "If you previously relied on automatic retry inside streaming, switch to client-side retry+resume to guarantee no duplication."

sophie: good call — removed references to tenacity. added the migration blurb and a short checklist for maintainers: update SDK snippets, add unit/integration example, update changelog.

docs-ci-bot: link-checker failed: anchor https://docs.redwood.ai/streams#resume-stream not found (404).

sophie: thanks bot — will fix that anchor and instead link to the new /guides/stream-resume doc (PR updated).

raul: do we want a tiny diagram or ascii flow for "client receives chunk -> saves cursor -> on transient error retry with cursor"? could be helpful for product readers.

sophie: added a one-paragraph ASCII flow in the PR and a short code comment showing where to persist cursor to DB/redis for long-lived resumption.

tim: LGTM from my side pending the link fix and one more cross-check against the TS snippet for AbortController behavior.
maria: approved, left one wording nit on "idempotent resume" -> "idempotent resume/resumption".

sophie: addressed both. plan: merge after CI passes and we'll backport to the v1.8 docs branch for Dedicated customers. tagging @eng-runtime for the migration note visibility. target: merge by EOD tomorrow unless blockers. :rocket:

raul: I'll drop a short note in eng-runtime channel so infra teams see the resume pattern.
sophie: thanks all — appreciate the quick reviews. if anything else pops up, reply here and I'll patch the PR. :slightly_smiling_face:
